_doc: The v0.2 strays, caretakers and summons that no Pulp Wars sprite fits (docs/design/CONTENT_CREATURES.md); the reused ones are byte-identical imports listed in docs/art/IMPORTED_FROM_PULP_WARS.md. Neutral creatures belong to no faction, so their colours avoid the three faction signatures (Realm crimson with gold-yellow, Restless near-black with violet, Horde lime with hazard yellow); every colour is in the subject. Figures use the unit class; the pumpkin and the seedling use the Pulp Wars creature class (no weapon, no clothes). Small creatures are generated small and padded bottom-centred into 56x80. Faces south-east, never mirrored. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

recipes.subject: Subject: Bellhop, a chunky cute little wind-up tin bellhop with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a small body: a round polished pale tin face with painted rosy cheeks and a fixed smile, a small round teal pillbox cap with a chin strap, a teal bellboy jacket with two rows of brass buttons, a big brass wind-up key sticking out of its back, an oversized cream suitcase carried in both hands, small dark grey shoes; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a clockwork toy servant, not a soldier.

Subject: Whipping Boy, a chunky cute sad scruffy boy with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a skinny body: messy dark hair, big droopy teary eyes, a sticking plaster on the cheek and a bandage round the head, a patched pale oatmeal-grey sackcloth smock with a rope belt, a big round wooden pot lid held up in front as a shield, bare feet; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a timid scapegoat, not a soldier.
recipes.negative: dirt, grass patch, sword, armour, helmet, red, purple, blood

recipes.subject: Subject: Lamplighter, a chunky cute old lamplighter with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a tiny sturdy body: a bushy white moustache and rosy nose, a dark navy blue peaked cap and a long navy blue coat with brass buttons, an oversized long pole topped with a small brass lantern holding a bright yellow flame held upright in the right hand, dark grey boots; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a night-time street worker.
recipes.negative: dirt, grass patch, sword, shield, armour, red, purple

recipes.subject: Subject: Newsie, a chunky cute newspaper boy with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a small body: a big floppy grey flat cap, a cheeky face with the mouth wide open shouting, a cream shirt with rolled sleeves, grey braces and grey knee breeches, a canvas satchel stuffed with newspapers on the hip, one rolled-up newspaper waved high in the right hand, dark grey boots; simple shapes and very few details; clearly shouting the headlines.
recipes.negative: dirt, grass patch, sword, shield, armour, red, purple, text, letters

recipes.subject: Subject: Notary, a chunky cute stern little clerk with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a tiny body: a bald head with grey side whiskers, small round spectacles and a prim frown, a quill pen behind the ear, a bottle-green frock coat with a cream ruffled collar, grey trousers, an oversized wooden rubber stamp with a deep blue ink face held up high in both hands, ready to stamp; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a pompous official, not a soldier.
recipes.negative: dirt, grass patch, sword, shield, armour, red, purple, text, letters

recipes.subject: Subject: Crooner, a chunky cute suave lounge singer with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a tiny body: slicked-back glossy black hair, half-closed dreamy eyes and a big smile, a white tuxedo jacket with a black bow tie and a pink carnation, black trousers and shoes, an oversized old silver radio microphone held in front of his mouth in the right hand, the left arm spread wide; three small pale blue music notes floating beside him; simple shapes and very few details.
recipes.negative: dirt, grass patch, sword, shield, armour, guitar, red, purple

recipes.subject: Subject: Loan Shark, a chunky cute blue-grey shark standing upright on two short legs like a man, with a huge round shark head about half of its height: a white belly and jaw, a wide grin full of white teeth, small shifty eyes, a dorsal fin on its back, a cream pinstripe waistcoat, a small round dark grey bowler hat, an oversized ledger book held under one fin and a big gold coin flipped in the other; short grey legs with dark shoes; simple shapes and very few details.
recipes.negative: dirt, grass patch, water, waves, sword, shield, red, purple

recipes.subject: Subject: Groundskeeper, a chunky cute walking topiary hedge creature with a huge round leafy head about half of its height and a stubby body: neatly clipped bright leaf-green hedge with small pink flowers, big round friendly eyes peeking out of the leaves, a little straw sun hat, stubby twig arms and root feet, oversized silver garden shears held in both hands; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a gardener spirit, not a tree.
recipes.negative: dirt, grass patch, trunk, tree, sword, shield, red, purple

recipes.subject: Subject: Gumshoe, a chunky cute pulp detective with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a tiny sturdy body: a squinting suspicious face with a square jaw, a grey fedora pulled low, a pale khaki trench coat with the collar turned up and a belt, an oversized magnifying glass held up in the left hand, a small dark grey snub pistol in the right hand, dark grey shoes; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a private eye.
recipes.negative: dirt, grass patch, sword, shield, armour, rifle, red, purple

recipes.subject: Subject: Deep-Sea Diver, a chunky cute deep-sea diver with a huge round brass diving helmet about half of the figure's height and a stout body: three round glass portholes on the helmet, a friendly face behind the front one, a bulky pale grey-blue canvas diving suit, big dark grey gloves, heavy dark grey lead boots, a coiled cream air hose over the shoulder, an oversized harpoon gun held in both hands; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a heavy slow diver.
recipes.negative: dirt, grass patch, water, bubbles, fish, red, purple

recipes.subject: Subject: Sexton, a chunky cute gaunt old churchyard sexton with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a thin body: pale yellowish-white wrinkled skin, a long nose, thin lips and bushy grey eyebrows, a battered grey felt hat, a long dusty slate-blue coat, a lit tin lantern with a soft pale yellow flame in the left hand and an oversized spade over the right shoulder, dark grey boots; simple shapes and very few details; a living old man, not a skeleton.
recipes.negative: skull, skeleton, zombie, purple, violet, red

recipes.subject: Subject: Fire-Eater, a chunky cute circus fire-eater with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a stocky body: a bald head with a big curled black moustache, cheeks puffed, a bare chest, baggy orange and white striped circus trousers with a wide orange sash, a flaming torch held up in the right hand, a big bright orange and yellow flame blowing out of his mouth to the right; dark grey slippers; simple shapes and very few details.
recipes.negative: dirt, grass patch, sword, shield, armour, red cloth, purple

recipes.subject: Subject: Prize Pumpkin, a huge chunky cute living pumpkin creature filling the whole width of the image: a big round bright orange pumpkin body with deep ribs and a darker orange shadow, a carved cheerful face with big round eyes and a grin, a curly green stem and two big green leaves on top, short stubby green vine legs, a big blue prize rosette ribbon pinned on its front; simple shapes and very few details.

Subject: Beanstalk Giant, a huge chunky cute storybook giant, the biggest creature of all, filling the whole width of the image: a huge round head about half of his height with a big bulbous nose, bushy ginger eyebrows and a gap-toothed grin, a patched oatmeal-cream tunic with a rope belt, big bare arms, a huge green beanstalk club with leaves and pea pods held over his shoulder, big dark grey boots; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a giant, not a troll or an ogre.
recipes.negative: dirt, grass patch, green skin, tusks, armour, red, purple

recipes.subject: Subject: Seedling, a tiny chunky cute sprout creature: a round pale green bean-shaped body with a lighter belly, big round black eyes and a small smile, two bright green leaves sprouting from the top of its head, tiny root feet; simple shapes and very few details.
recipes.negative: dirt, grass patch, pot, soil, flower, red, purple

recipes.subject: Subject: Shade, a chunky cute small shadow spirit with a huge round head about half of its height: a smoky dark slate-blue body that tapers into a curly wisp tail instead of legs, two big round pale cyan glowing eyes and a small shy smile, two stubby smoky arms, a thin pale cyan rim along its left side; all in solid opaque colours; it hovers, the tip of its tail is the lowest thing in the image; simple shapes and very few details.
recipes.negative: dirt, grass patch, skull, bones, robe, weapon, purple, violet, red, see-through

recipes.subject: Subject: Sexton, a chunky cute gaunt old churchyard sexton with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a thin body: pale yellowish-white wrinkled skin, a long nose, thin lips and bushy grey eyebrows, a battered grey felt hat, a long dusty slate-blue coat, a lit tin lantern with a soft pale yellow flame in the left hand and an oversized flat square-bladed digging spade held upright in the right hand, dark grey boots standing on nothing; simple shapes and very few details; a living old man, not a skeleton.
recipes.negative: dirt, grass patch, axe, skull, skeleton, zombie, purple, violet, red
recipes.notes: sexton-a stood on a soil patch and its spade read as an axe: the spade is square-bladed and upright, dirt and axe excluded.

recipes.subject: Remove all ground: erase the dirt slab and grass tufts under the feet, so the figure stands directly on a transparent background with nothing at all under it. Keep the figure, its colours, the thick black outline and the art style exactly the same.
recipes.notes: Ground-removal edit of newsie-a#0 (LESSONS 5.2 edit text).

recipes.subject: Remove all ground: erase the round grass and soil plate under the feet, so the figure stands directly on a transparent background with nothing at all under it. Keep the figure, its colours, the thick black outline and the art style exactly the same.

Subject: Notary, a chunky cute stern little clerk with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a tiny body: a bald head with grey side whiskers, small round spectacles and a prim frown, a quill pen behind the ear, a bottle-green frock coat with a cream ruffled collar, grey trousers, a huge wooden rubber stamp shaped like a mushroom, a round knob handle on top and a flat deep blue inked face underneath, raised high in both hands, ready to stamp; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a pompous official.
recipes.negative: dirt, grass patch, telescope, horn, gun, sword, shield, red, purple, text, letters
recipes.notes: notary-a's stamp came back as a brass spyglass or horn: the stamp shape described, telescope and horn excluded.

recipes.subject: Subject: Shade, a small chunky cute ghostly shadow spirit hovering in the air: a big round head about half of its height and a smoky dark slate-blue body that tapers into one curly wisp tail instead of legs, two big round pale cyan glowing eyes and a small shy smile, two stubby smoky arms raised; solid opaque colours; it floats with nothing under it, and the tip of its tail is the lowest thing in the image.
recipes.negative: grass block, ground tile, cat, ears, legs, skull, purple
recipes.notes: shade-a stood on an isometric grass block, grew cat ears and legs and held a prop: the creature class (no tool), hovering, ground and cat words excluded.

recipes.subject: Remove all ground: erase the isometric block of soil, grass and snow under the spirit, leaving that area transparent, so the spirit floats on a transparent background with nothing at all under it. Keep the spirit, its colours, the curly tail, the thick black outline and the art style exactly the same.
